meta.redesign: 2026-10-04: zinc neutrals, dark + light themes, one modern brand blue with on-accent, Geist + Geist Mono, 8/12/16px radii (pills only for badges and chips), tonal status badges, blurred dialog overlay, 4px spacing scale.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything (html/body), with one faint top glow. Also the 2px offset inside the focus ring.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the sidebar drawer, the hamburger button and the login card. Body copy on it is text.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs (Cortar vídeo, Renomear, Excluir, Histórico de tentativas) and the sticky footer of the cut dialog. One step above surface in dark; white in light.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for nav items, ghost/secondary buttons, icon buttons, table rows, the file picker; also the table header band.

tokens.name: surface-active
tokens.usage: The active sidebar item (visible against the drawer) and the empty part of the trim track. Also the video-card hover border.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Background of a .toggle-group (segmented control) track.

tokens.name: segment-active
tokens.usage: The selected segment inside a .toggle-group (.pill-toggle-active), with a hairline border and shadow-sm.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Fill of inputs, textareas, selects and the file picker.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline, decorative only: cards, dialogs, table rows, dividers, icon-button outline, toggle-group track. Below 3:1 on purpose; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Boundary of controls that need one: inputs, select, file picker (dashed), secondary button, filter chips, the Switch off track. At least 3:1 on bg, surface, field and surface-raised in both themes (dark 3.4-3.8:1, light 3.1-3.3:1).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy, headings, active nav, input text. Reads on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-hover and field (dark 15.7-19:1, light 18-19.9:1).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, filter-row labels, table headers, inactive nav and segments, hints, dialog subtitles, Cancelar. On bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-hover (dark 6.4-7.8:1, light 7.0-7.7:1).

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and the no-preview message on the media well. On bg, surface and field (dark 4.8-5.1:1, light 5.1-5.3:1). Never for content that must be read.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary action (.btn-primary, .btn-light, .icon-btn-solid): near-white in dark, near-black in light. Text on it is on-primary.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of primary actions.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary (dark 19:1, light 17:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The brand blue, in small areas only: eyebrows, the role label, the active nav icon, links in tables, active filter chips (text + border), Switch on, the selected trim range and handles, the Palavra Completa badge and the focus ring. 4.5:1+ as text on bg, surface and surface-raised in both themes (dark 6.4-7.2:1, light 5.0-5.2:1).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state for accent text links.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text or icon placed on a solid accent fill (dark 6.9:1, light 5.2:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tonal fill behind accent text: active filter chips, the Palavra Completa badge, text selection. accent on it stays above 4.5:1 (dark 5.6:1, light 4.65:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text (.error-text) on bg, surface and surface-raised (dark 6.4-7.2:1, light 4.6-4.8:1).

tokens.name: danger-solid
tokens.usage: Fill of the one button that confirms a deletion, inside the delete dialog. Never on cards.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger-solid (4.8:1).

tokens.name: knob
tokens.usage: Switch knob and the 2px ring of the trim handles.

tokens.name: status-fila
tokens.usage: Text and dot of Fila (submission) and Original (clip) badges, on status-fila-soft (dark 6.0:1, light 6.7:1).

tokens.name: status-fila-soft
tokens.usage: Tonal fill of Fila / Original badges.

tokens.name: status-baixando
tokens.usage: Text and dot of Baixando (submission) and Processando (clip) badges, on its soft fill (dark 6.0:1, light 5.8:1).

tokens.name: status-baixando-soft
tokens.usage: Tonal fill of Baixando / clip Processando badges.

tokens.name: status-processando
tokens.usage: Text and dot of Processando (submission) and Rascunho (clip) badges, on its soft fill (dark 8.6:1, light 6.2:1).

tokens.name: status-processando-soft
tokens.usage: Tonal fill of Processando / Rascunho badges.

tokens.name: status-concluido
tokens.usage: Text and dot of Concluído and Cortado badges (dark 8.3:1, light 6.3:1 on the soft fill); success text and the code inside the success callout.

tokens.name: status-concluido-soft
tokens.usage: Tonal fill of Concluído / Cortado badges and of the success callout.

tokens.name: status-erro
tokens.usage: Text and dot of the Erro badge (dark 5.7:1, light 5.5:1 on the soft fill); the current-failure line in the attempt history.

tokens.name: status-erro-soft
tokens.usage: Tonal fill of the Erro badge.

tokens.name: type-pregacao
tokens.usage: Text of the Pregação type badge, on type-pregacao-soft (dark 7.3:1, light 6.8:1). Used for nothing else.

tokens.name: type-pregacao-soft
tokens.usage: Tonal fill of the Pregação badge.

tokens.name: type-louvor
tokens.usage: Text of the Louvor and Música completa badges, on type-louvor-soft (dark 9.7:1, light 4.8:1). Used for nothing else.

tokens.name: type-louvor-soft
tokens.usage: Tonal fill of the Louvor / Música completa badges.

tokens.name: type-podcast
tokens.usage: Text of the Podcast badge, on type-podcast-soft (dark 8.4:1, light 6.5:1). Used for nothing else.

tokens.name: type-podcast-soft
tokens.usage: Tonal fill of the Podcast badge.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind every dialog, combined with a 4px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Scrim behind the sidebar drawer below 720px.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The single faint radial glow at the top of the page ground. Decorative.

tokens.name: skeleton-base
tokens.usage: Skeleton shimmer base stops (25% and 63%).

tokens.name: skeleton-highlight
tokens.usage: Skeleton shimmer highlight stop (37%).

tokens.name: thumb-from
tokens.usage: Start of the 135deg gradient behind a clip thumbnail.

tokens.name: thumb-to
tokens.usage: End of the 135deg gradient behind a clip thumbnail.

tokens.name: media-well
tokens.usage: Letterbox behind the cut-dialog video and its no-preview placeholder. Black in both themes.

tokens.name: on-media
tokens.usage: Text over video or the duration badge (white in both themes, 9.3:1+ on duration-bg).

tokens.name: duration-bg
tokens.usage: Duration badge fill over a thumbnail.

tokens.name: play-glyph
tokens.usage: The CSS triangle shown on a thumbnail when a clip has no image.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one h1 per page, under an eyebrow.

styles.name: title-section
styles.usage: Card headings on the settings page (h2.card-title).

styles.name: title-modal
styles.usage: Dialog titles: Cortar vídeo, Renomear clipe, Excluir clipe, Histórico de tentativas.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Cole o link do vídeo completo do YouTube.
styles.usage: Page intro copy under the h1 (.page-intro, text-muted).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Essa ação não pode ser desfeita.
styles.usage: Default copy, input text, table cells, dialog body. Inputs switch to 16px below 720px so iOS does not zoom on focus.

styles.name: clip-name
styles.usage: Clip hook on a video card, clamped to two lines.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels (text), setting titles, the section label (text-muted).

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Card meta line, the sort select, dialog subtitles, table dates, attempt reasons. Tabular numbers where digits line up.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Trim timecodes, clip status dates, setting hints, table headers (500). Always tabular-nums for numbers.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Status badges, type badges, filter chips, the role label, the duration badge.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The product name at the top of the sidebar, in text. This is the logo; there is no image mark.

styles.name: eyebrow-label
styles.usage: Uppercase section label above every h1 (Biblioteca, Automação, Administração, Clip Studio on login), in accent.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Half step: badge inner gap, the Switch knob inset, sidebar link gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between badges and between toggle segments; toggle-group padding; eyebrow-to-title gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Label-to-input gap; gap in button rows, filter rows and dialog footers; duration badge inset.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding; nav item padding; space under error text; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Field stack rhythm (.field margin-bottom); card body padding on video cards; table cell horizontal padding; mobile page gutter; scrim padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Cut dialog padding; space above the trim stepper row.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Form card and dialog padding; page-header bottom margin; filters bottom margin; desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Space between stacked form cards; login card side padding.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Login card top/bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding; main bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Reserved for large section breaks.

tokens.name: space-72
tokens.usage: Main content top padding, leaving room for the fixed hamburger.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Skeleton bars, duration badge, trim track and range.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Segments inside a toggle-group (one step inside the track's radius-md).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Every control: buttons, inputs, select, file picker, icon buttons, nav items, hamburger, toggle-group track, callouts, the cut-dialog video.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and the empty-state frame.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the login card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Only badges (status, type), filter chips and the Switch. Buttons are never pills.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards, the active segment, the Switch knob and trim handles: a barely-there lift. Separation still comes from the hairline border.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the login card, together with the blurred overlay.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus (:focus-visible only): 2px offset in the ground color + 2px accent ring. Accent is 7.2:1 (dark) / 5.0:1 (light) on bg.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Drawer width; content shifts by the same amount above 720px.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the main column.

tokens.name: form-max
tokens.usage: Max width of form cards and page intro copy.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs and nav items.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, small buttons (.btn-sm), the select and segments.

tokens.name: chip-height
tokens.usage: Filter chips.

tokens.name: hamburger
tokens.usage: Fixed menu button, 16px from the top-left corner.

tokens.name: dialog-sm
tokens.usage: Rename dialog max width (Delete uses 440px).

tokens.name: dialog-md
tokens.usage: Attempt-history dialog max width.

tokens.name: dialog-cut
tokens.usage: Cut dialog max width.

tokens.name: login-max
tokens.usage: Login card max width.

motion.note: Transition timings; everything collapses to ~0 under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, color and border transitions; the Switch knob. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-drawer
tokens.usage: Sidebar slide and the content shift beside it (ease).

tokens.name: z-backdrop
tokens.usage: Drawer scrim on narrow screens.

tokens.name: z-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar drawer.

tokens.name: z-hamburger
tokens.usage: Menu button stays above the open drawer.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Every dialog overlay.
